changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Add explicit salary-structure calculation basis so CTC can be split by fixed annual amount, percentage of CTC, or percentage of basic.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE "${schema}".salary_structure_component SET calculation_basis = CASE WHEN percentage_of_basic IS NOT NULL THEN 'PERCENT_OF_BASIC' ELSE 'FIXED_ANNUAL' END, calculation_value = COALESCE(percentage_of_basic, amount, calculation_value);
ALTER TABLE "${schema}".salary_structure_component ADD CONSTRAINT chk_salary_structure_component_calc_basis CHECK (calculation_basis IN ('FIXED_ANNUAL','FIXED_MONTHLY','PERCENT_OF_CTC','PERCENT_OF_BASIC'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".salary_structure_component DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_salary_structure_component_calc_basis;

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Employee-specific salary component overrides support one-off fixed/custom component values without mutating the shared salary structure.

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Add explicit asset read/self permissions; manager access remains assets:manage.

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Preserve manager/admin behavior by granting assets:read/self to roles that already manage assets or employee records.
changeSet.sql: WITH wanted_permission AS ( SELECT permission.id FROM "${schema}".permission AS permission WHERE permission.resource = 'assets' AND permission.action IN ('read', 'self') ), manager_role AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tenant_role.id FROM "${schema}".role AS tenant_role WHERE tenant_role.is_deleted = false AND ( UPPER(TRIM(tenant_role.name)) IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'TENANT_ADMIN', 'ORG_ADMIN') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".role_permission AS role_permission JOIN "${schema}".permission AS permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE role_permission.role_id = tenant_role.id AND ( (permission.resource = 'assets' AND permission.action = 'manage') OR (permission.resource = 'employee' AND permission.action IN ('write','manage')) ) ) ) ) INSERT INTO "${schema}".role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT manager_role.id, wanted_permission.id FROM manager_role CROSS JOIN wanted_permission ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Every authenticated employee role may view only its own assigned assets; backend ownership checks still prevent cross-employee access.
changeSet.sql: WITH self_permission AS ( SELECT permission.id FROM "${schema}".permission AS permission WHERE permission.resource = 'assets' AND permission.action = 'self' ) INSERT INTO "${schema}".role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT tenant_role.id, self_permission.id FROM "${schema}".role AS tenant_role CROSS JOIN self_permission WHERE tenant_role.is_deleted = false ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Prevent concurrent requests or stale asset status from assigning the same asset to more than one active employee allocation.

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Keep employee salary effective-dated history deterministic when HR corrects or replaces an assignment on the same effective date.
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_employee_salary_structure_effective_date ON "${schema}".employee_salary_structure (tenant_id, employee_id, effective_from);
